subject: TDPF
title: Studies in Performance—Fall Production
description: The in-depth study for a fully staged fall dance production directed and choreographed by faculty, graduate students, and/or guest artists in collaboration with student performers. Admission by audition only. May be taken for credit up to six times for a maximum of twelve units.
prerequisites_text: audition; department approval; concurrent enrollment in TDMV 110, 111, 112, 120, 122, 130, or 133.

subject: TDPF
title: Studies in Performance—Winter Production
description: The in-depth study for a fully staged winter dance production directed and choreographed by faculty and/or guest artists in collaboration with student performers. Admission by audition only. May be taken for credit up to six times for a maximum of twelve units.
prerequisites_text: audition, department approval, concurrent enrollment in TDMV 110 or TDMV 111 or TDMV 112 or TDMV 120 or TDMV 122 or TDMV 130 or TDMV 133.

subject: TDPF
title: Studies in Performance Spring Production
description: A full spring production featuring the original choreographic work of undergraduate dance students, developed under the mentorship and direction of a faculty member. Admission by audition only. May be taken for credit up to six times for a maximum of twelve units.
prerequisites_text: audition, department approval, concurrent enrollment in TDMV 110 or TDMV 111 or TDMV 112 or TDMV 120 or TDMV 122 or TDMV 130 or TDMV 133.

subject: TDPF
title: Dance Repertory
description: The study and aesthetic examination of major choreographic works by dance faculty or distinguished guest artists. Students will experience the creative process, staging, production, and performance of a complete dance work in conjunction with a conceptual study of its form and content. Audition is required. May be taken for credit up to six times for a maximum of twelve units.

subject: TDPF
title: Major Project/Dance Production
description: Students develop skills in directing and producing an independent staged dance concert/production in various settings. May be taken for credit two times.
